diagnostics.message: declares the phrasing "fluxo de conformidade alfa", which workflow:conformance.workflow.linear already claims under the same normal form. Two routes advertising one sentence do not degrade selection, they make it a coin flip — the customer gets a confidently-executed wrong route, and both sides look correct in isolation. Settle it here: one of the two owns the phrasing.
